The Builder's geometry matches that design: five 12 mm sensors at x -0.02 to +0.02 m, y 0.06 m, wheel_radius 0.03 m, wheel_track 0.12 m, mass 0.8 kg, body 0.12 by 0.16 m. All values are inside the contract limits.

I keep the controller unchanged (base_speed 1.6, kp 3.0, ki 0, kd 0.2, weights [-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1], last_direction). The Builder asks whether a higher kd or lower base_speed would recover s-bend progress. The telemetry does not support that change. Steering oscillation is 0.10 to 0.14, so there is no sign of lag-driven overshoot that more kd would fix. Line loss is a single dropout at a fixed point, and no controller change in this run has been measured to remove it. Any untested controller change could cost the oval gain, and there is no later iteration to recover from a mistake. Holding the pairing fixed keeps the result comparable to the known 52.985.
